Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Syed Ali Imam
Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Surendra Singh-I,J.
Short-counter affidavit has been filed by learned A.G.A. for the State which is taken on record.

Heard Sri Rajesh Kumar, learned counsel for the petitioners and Sri G.P. Singh, learned A.G.A. for
the State.

The present writ petition has been preferred with the prayer to quash the impugned first information report dated 07.12.2020 registered as Case Crime No. 316 of 2020 under Sections 498A, 323, 307 I.P.C. and 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station- Nidhauli Kalan, District- Etah, and for a direction to the respondents not to arrest the petitioners in pursuance of the impugned first information report.

In view of above, the writ petition is dismissed as having become infructuous.
